task_summary: Resolved panelist assignment failure by expanding backend role check to include all verified faculty roles ('faculty', 'adviser', 'panelist') with mutual exclusion conflict-of-interest guards; relocated Project Context, Academic Reports, Evaluation Summary, and executive KPIs directly into the Capstone Milestone Progression stepper; consolidated Faculty Committee into a space-saving button opening an accessible modal dialog; eliminated redundant UI by discarding the 4-column right sidebar on MyProjectPage and ProjectDetailPage; adhered strictly to Shneiderman's 8 Golden Rules and Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics; and verified with 16 targeted client/server unit tests, 209/190 endpoint parity (UNMATCHED_COUNT=0), 60/60 agentic validation checks, and full Playwright visual audit across desktop and mobile viewports in light and dark modes.
lessons_learned: Institutional Faculty Role Normalization: BukSU accounts created for faculty have primary role 'faculty'. The backend panelist assignment logic previously compared user.role !== 'panelist', blocking faculty members like Louie Labastida from being appointed. Expanding the allowed set to ['faculty', 'panelist', 'adviser'] (while excluding 'instructor' and 'student') resolves assignment while preserving committee role integrity.

Mutual Exclusion / Conflict of Interest: Faculty members appointed as advisers cannot be assigned as panelists on the same project, and panelists cannot be appointed as advisers. This must be validated defensively on backend service layers.

Full-Width Cockpit vs Sidebar Clutter: Replacing a persistent 4-column right sidebar with inline KPI cards, project context metadata strips, and modal dialog buttons within CapstoneWorkflowStepper frees 33% of horizontal screen width, giving users an expansive, distraction-free workspace for document review, Gantt scheduling, and Action Done Matrix auditing.
